name: Unter Null
description: '''Unter Null''' (from [[German language|German]]; [[English language|Eng]].: "Below Zero") is an American [[Dark electro|dark]] [[Electro-industrial|electro]]-[[industrial music]] act, founded in 1998 as a solo [[aggrotech]] project by '''Erica Dunham''', when Dunham was age 17 and living in [[Seattle]] in the [[Northwestern United States]]. Dunham is trained in [[Piano|classical piano]], [[cello]] and [[guitar]]. Live performances consist of Dunham on lead vocals, Brendin Ross (formerly of the band [[Bile (band)|Bile]]) on keyboards and Krz Souls (of the band [[Dawn of Ashes]]), on e-percussion. {{As of|2012}}, Unter Null is based in [[Portland, Oregon]].
